title: Glazing Paperwork Done for You | RAMS, Signed Notes, Branded Quotes | Coglass
description: RAMS started from the survey, signed collection and delivery notes, purchase orders with the drawing, and branded quotes, invoices and emails — produced by Coglass from the job.
lead: Everything you need to send or keep is built from what is already on the job: a risk assessment started from the survey, signed notes when glass is collected or delivered, purchase orders with the drawing on them, and quotes and invoices in your branding.
steps_sub: The survey, the work bench and the sign-off on site feed every document — nobody types it twice.
steps: The access level recorded on the survey starts the equipment list on a new risk assessment in the phone app.
Branded quote PDFs with the glass drawn on each line; purchase orders to your supplier with the same drawing.
The customer signs on screen; the signed note is stored on the job.
A branded invoice PDF, emailed in your layout, with a link to pay online.
inc_sub: All in your logo and colours, all kept on the job.
included: Scaffold, ladders, harness: the access level on the survey fills the equipment list on a new RAMS in the phone app.
Risk assessment and method statement as a branded PDF, kept on the job.
Itemised, signed on screen with the collector's name, and emailed to the customer.
With the customer's signature and a proof photo, ready to download.
Your logo and colour, the glass drawn on each line, and a link to accept online.
Deposit, proforma and final invoices with totals, balance and a pay-online link.
Numbered per job, with the pane drawn on the PO, emailed to the supplier with the PDF attached.
A cutting-sheet PDF for the workshop, grouped by station.
Every customer email uses one layout with your logo — and you can write your own templates.
cta_p: Book a demo and we will show you the documents from one of your own jobs — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
